---
title: "Reading Data from the Web"
author: "Max Hyman"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr)
```

```{r}
url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"

drug_use_html = 
  read_html(url)

drug_use_html
```

```{r}
drug_use_html |> 
  html_table() |> 
  first() |> 
  slice(-1)
```
